gloss: the point of an argument; the gist; the main thrust

definitions.gloss: the point of an argument; the gist; the main thrust
definitions.explanation: The central point a written argument or essay is trying to make — what the author is actually claiming, as opposed to the surrounding examples, background, or asides. A word from formal writing and academic language.

examples.japanese: {論旨|ろんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: The point of the argument is clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{論旨|ろんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめ→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Summarize the main point of this passage.
I agree with the author's main argument, but I have doubts about the choice of examples.

examples.japanese: {論旨|ろんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧しまっており、{読|よ}み{手|て}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{筆者|ひっしゃ}→筆者：04348_hissha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧にくい。
examples.english: The thrust of the argument shifts partway through, and it is hard for the reader to tell what the author wants to say.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (argument, discussion, theory) + {旨|し} (meaning, purport, gist). A formal written word meaning "the core point the argument is making." It appears constantly in essays, academic writing, book reviews, and high-school Japanese textbooks — especially in reading-comprehension questions that ask students to identify the author's {論旨|ろんし}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {論旨|ろんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧だ: the point is clear / the argument is well-focused
- {論旨|ろんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不明確|ふめいかく}→不明確：24357_fumeikaku⟧だ: the point is unclear
- {論旨|ろんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to summarize the main point
- {論旨|ろんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧: to follow the line of an argument
- {論旨|ろんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれる→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧: the argument drifts off topic
- {論旨|ろんし}⟦{明快|めいかい}→明快：15352_meikai⟧: clear and lucid in its argument — a common set phrase of praise for an essay
- {論旨|ろんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賛同|さんどう}→賛同：14257_sandou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to agree with the main point of an argument

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主旨|しゅし}→主旨：28961_shushi⟧: main point; gist — the central point of any piece of writing or speech; overlaps heavily with {論旨|ろんし} but is not limited to arguments.
- ⟦{要旨|ようし}→要旨：04087_youshi⟧: summary; gist — the condensed content of a passage (the abstract of a paper, for example).
- ⟦{趣旨|しゅし}→趣旨：05629_shushi⟧: intent; purpose; gist — the aim or intent behind something, not just its argumentative point; used for proposals, laws, meetings, and essays.
- ⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧: conclusion — the final claim arrived at, not the overall line of reasoning.

USAGE:
Use {論旨|ろんし} only when talking about writing or discussion that has an "argument" in it — an essay, editorial, paper, or debate. For the general idea of a casual conversation or a story, use ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要点|ようてん}→要点：01668_youten⟧ or ⟦{要旨|ようし}→要旨：04087_youshi⟧ instead. Common in school reading exercises: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{論旨|ろんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{百字|ひゃくじ}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦まとめ→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧ (summarize the main argument of the following passage in 100 characters or less).
